summary: Deployment Automation review (Phase 4): CI coverage + GHCR image, tag-triggered CD with automatic rollback, zero-downtime graceful reload, and quantified DR/monitoring documentation. Operations moves from manual-SSH to automated shipping. Docker build was not executed locally (daemon offline); Dockerfile follows the documented stack and YAML/bash were validated instead.

checks.name: ci-gate
checks.detail: ci.yml: ruff, bandit, pip-audit, migration-drift check, compilemessages, tests with coverage (coverage.xml artifact), collectstatic, check --deploy; runs on main and release/1.0

checks.name: cd-pipeline
checks.detail: cd.yml: tag v* -> appleboy/ssh-action -> scripts/deploy.sh <ref> -> /health/ probe -> scripts/rollback.sh on failure; rollback is app-only (no migration reversal, documented)

checks.name: docker-image
checks.detail: Dockerfile (python:3.12-slim, gettext+libmagic, gunicorn config.wsgi) + .dockerignore; CI builds and pushes to GHCR on push. Local build not run: docker daemon offline on dev box

checks.name: zero-downtime
checks.detail: deploy.sh now reloads gracefully (systemctl reload -> HUP via ExecReload) with restart fallback; docs §3 ExecReload + §11 limits stated honestly (no zero-downtime DB strategy yet)

checks.name: dr-objectives
checks.detail: docs §12: RPO <= 15 min target vs current daily-backup reality (up to 24h) called out; RTO <= 30 min achievable via tested restore; quarterly drill mandated

checks.name: post-deploy-monitoring
checks.detail: docs §13 checklist: gunicorn, journal, redis, postgres connections, disk, TLS expiry, rate-limit keying, audit IP; Celery honestly marked not-in-stack

checks.name: validation
checks.detail: workflow YAML valid (pyyaml); deploy.sh/rollback.sh/healthcheck.sh pass bash -n; BRL validator PASS; 187 md files 0 broken links

checks.name: roadmap
checks.detail: Phase 4 retitled Deployment Automation & Observability; new items checked; WAL archiving + blue/green left open as next work

notes: Activation blocker: the repo has no git remote yet, so GitHub Actions will not run until origin is added and the branch/tags are pushed (docs/deployment.md §14 covers secrets and server prerequisites). No secrets were introduced; the GITHUB_TOKEN default is used for GHCR.
